test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A man sold an article at a gain of 57%. If he had sold it for ₹238 more, he would have gained 82%. The cost price (in ₹) of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

Gain = 57%

Extra selling price = ₹238

New gain = 82%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)</p&g
